gate: HIGH-02 remediation: multi-dimensional, outcome-independent reference-ECG quality gate. ELIGIBLE requires BOTH: (1) primary_r_peaks_per_min >= 40.0 (Pan-Tompkins-lite detector), AND (2) detector_agreement_ratio_primary_over_secondary >= 0.50 (cross-check against an independent amplitude-threshold detector, scipy.signal.find_peaks - a genuinely different algorithm family). Both dimensions are computed purely from the raw reference ECG signal and detector behavior - neither uses model performance.

p01_specific_adjudication: P01 (primary rate 37.08/min, agreement ratio 0.423) fails BOTH independent dimensions. On the agreement-ratio dimension alone, P01 (0.423) clusters with the 5 obviously-corrupted subjects (0.001-0.408), sitting only 0.015 above the highest of them (P19, 0.408) and 0.148 below the lowest genuinely-eligible subject (P05, 0.571) - a real, substantial gap on a dimension where P01 was never a marginal case. P01 also has the single highest RR-implausible-fraction (0.176) of any subject outside the obviously-corrupted cluster (max among the 18 eligible: 0.070, P05). This is independent, multi-dimensional evidence, not a restatement of the single original peak-rate metric.
cohort_unchanged_note: This multi-dimensional rule produces the EXACT SAME 18-subject eligible cohort as the prior single-dimension (40 peaks/min) rule - verified by direct set comparison, zero symmetric difference. The cohort was not re-engineered to exclude P01; the composite rule was checked against the real data and happened to reproduce the same membership, which is itself evidence the original exclusion was not an arbitrary artifact of one metric.
